attacked_by_cannon: Congratulations! You have entered the city of Valoria, yet you are still being attacked by the enemies’ canons, Luckly…You have a canon too!
the_warden: Secure the inner districts and prevent any uprising by working alongside skilled yet variable-commitment soldiers. Engage them in planning and patrols to keep morale high and ensure no resistance can take root again.
the_marshal: Hold strategic points with eager but less experienced troops. Guide them step-by-step to fortify gates, bridges, and posts, turning their loyalty into disciplined, effective defense.
architect: Clear forests and gardens of any enemy remnants using elite, self-driven soldiers. Trust them to adapt and innovate while securing every hiding place without constant oversight.
overseer: Restore movement routes and strengthen military infrastructure with raw recruits. Issue clear, strict orders and closely monitor every step to avoid low commitment and ensure speed and accuracy.
commander: Control the Valoria River with inexperienced, low commited troops by enforcing strict discipline. Guard every pier, patrol the waters, and block all unauthorized movement under tight command.
